svg.aria-label: A grid of 140 turning cubes, one for each craftable item in ULTRA-SATISFACTORY, coloured across the rainbow row by row, with ULTRA in tall cyan outlined capitals up the left edge. Small white text reads: 140 craftable items, one cube each. 211 machine recipes, 88 of them alternates. 477 buildings, 9 of them production machines. 5 space elevator phases, 0 gradients.
